summary_md: **S. Tabayashi ([@s_tabayashi](https://x.com/s_tabayashi/status/2116308769214988297))** publishes a log of 2–3 months using Claude Code on an open mathematical-physics problem (the Pauli-Fierz model), with about 450 failed approaches. His provisional verdict is that AI produces answers but does not make math any easier ([tabayashi0117/pf-uv-research-log](https://github.com/tabayashi0117/pf-uv-research-log)).
